Comments (English): [ Run, don't walk, far away from this. ] || ---------------- || When my wife and I purchased this dishwasher almost two years ago we were so excited. It had so many features that were awesome for our family, such as the bottle jets and third rack, it was a dream for us. That dream turned into a nightmare though. At first the dishwasher seemed to be high quality, but then it would frequently backflow dirty water onto the dishes! It was so gross seeing that stuff on our supposedly clean dishes. We ended up having to hand wash our dishes before putting them into the dishwasher just so there was no food to back up. Several times I've had to take apart the insides of the dishwasher because the pieces fill up with this disgusting sludge and I have to scrub everything down. It leaks a little around the outer gasket so there is always just a little water around the dishwasher and the wheels on the lower rack break very easily. The only reason that we didn't get a new one is because it was this was so expensive to begin with. But, now, the touch screen has come off. I've never seen that happen in an appliance before. I can't run the dishwasher at all and we are back to hand washing dishes. A new user control panel is almost $200 to fix if I do it myself. We wish that we had purchased literally any other dishwasher. This is by far the worst quality I've ever seen.

Sentence (English): Honestly our dishwasher from the 90's was WAY better than this.
Comments (English): [ Modern is definitely not better ] || ---------------- || Honestly our dishwasher from the 90's was WAY better than this. It had a two hour cycle and actually got the dishes clean, regardless of if we scraped them clean or not. The only reason we got this one is because our old one died and this was covered under warranty. The good things about this dishwasher are the adjustable middle rack and the fact that it has a third rack at the top. It's also super quiet. Other than that, there is nothing good about it. I'm so disappointed in this product. We had someone come out to take a look at it at one point becuase it wasn't getting the dishes clean. Their solution was to make sure the "boost" temperature is always on and to thoroughly scrub our dishes of any and all residue before putting them in the dishwasher. Why have the boost feature as an option when you pretty much have to have it on every time you run the dishwasher? Not only that, but it adds an extra hour to the run time, so now our dishwasher runs for 3 hours instead of 2. Also, I know you're supposed to scrape off residue before loading dishes but with this model (and maybe all new-age models? ) you basically have to pre-scrub and pre-wash all of your dishes which means you have to do everything the dishwasher is supposed to do and you just have a box that runs a 3-hour hot water cycle. Now we've noticed that not only is it not getting the dishes clean, but it doesn't have any sort of drying feature built into the regular cycle so the dishes are always soaked when they are done and we get water spots on all of our dishes. This is WITH the use of rinse aid. Now they do have a dry boost feature but it also extends the cycle by almost an hour and I'll be darned if I want my dishwasher to run for 4 hours every time I run it.

I chose the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Counter Dishwasher because it is a size suitable for small households or apartments with a capacity of 6 people, and I decided to purchase it because the white color seemed to go well with the kitchen interior. In addition, the reliability of the Samsung brand had a big influence. Details The Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Counter Dishwasher DW30CB300CW0 is a 6-person dishwasher that provides the capacity to wash dishes for 6 people at once. This product is designed to be installed on the countertop, so it does not take up a part of the kitchen, but rather allows you to efficiently utilize the existing kitchen space. The white color goes well with any kitchen and gives a neat and sophisticated feel. It is equipped with various washing programs, so the washing efficiency is also excellent. In addition, the on-site installation service is included, so you can easily install it without any hassle when installing it for the first time. How to use The dishwasher is easy to use. Place the dishes inside the dishwasher, select the desired washing mode, and press the start button. The product has various washing options, so you can choose the program that suits your situation, from general washing to strong contamination removal. It is recommended to clean the filter after use, and once the washing is complete, you can take out the dishes and organize them. After installation, only basic maintenance and cleaning status checks are required. Practical use advantages The biggest advantages are space saving and efficiency. It provides an appropriate capacity for 6 people, so it can be used in small homes, and you can save kitchen space while having a washing function. Thanks to the various washing programs, you can wash dishes according to the degree of contamination, which is very convenient. The washing performance is also excellent, so you can wash dishes more cleanly than by hand. In addition, the on-site installation service is included, so installation is very easy, and as expected from a Samsung product, it is durable. Disappointing points The disappointing point is that the inside of the dishwasher is narrower than expected, so it may be difficult to wash large dishes or large pots. Also, there may be some noise during washing, which may be inconvenient for those who want a quiet environment. Water stains may remain during the initial washing after installation, so you need to clean them through several empty washes. Repurchase intention: O I am satisfied with the convenience of use and high space utilization. The performance and design are excellent enough to recommend to first-time dishwashers. I am willing to repurchase. One-line review: A space-saving, efficient 6-person dishwasher! If my review was helpful, please help me :)

Sentence (English): I'll start by saying this dishwasher works and does what it's designed to.
Comments (English): [ It just feels off ] || ---------------- || I'll start by saying this dishwasher works and does what it's designed to. I just don't feel it does it very well. The actual available space inside feels smaller than our last washer. I guess this is a result of buying one of the cheaper models available maybe. In any case, like I said it works. No major problems yet a few months in. I just would never buy this particular model again, nor recommend it.

Sentence (English): The Dishwasher itself works fine, hence the 2 stars.
Comments (English): [ Poor installation information ] || ---------------- || The Dishwasher itself works fine, hence the 2 stars. However, the costs I incurred from the installation substantially drained any value the dishwasher had. I see from the other reviews that Samsung.com uses subcontractors to perform installation, and in my case I think they did not have the right information on the product requirements. On their first visit, they refused to remove my old dishwasher because it was hardwired. That's understandable, but then they also told me that I needed a 110volt 20amp outlet, and specifically told me that my existing 120volt/15 amp outlet under the sink was inadequate. I'm pretty uneducated on electricity and took their word, hiring an electrician at great expense, who told me 110volt outlets were the same as 120volts and installed a new 120volt/20amp outlet with additional costs related to splitting the breakers related to having 2 different outlets under the sink. Later, I ended up reading through the dishwasher specs, and saw that my existing outlet was absolutely appropriate, and confirmed it with technical support. I guess the moral of the story is, read the product specifications ahead of time, and don't completely trust the service folks. But I'm still extremely unhappy about the excess expense and unnecessary outlet installation that I was advised to obtain by these 3rd party service contractors used by Samsung.com.

The drying result is also very disappointing. When you choose a fast program, you cannot choose extra dryness by having the door open automatically after the program. In that case, the machine is very wet inside when it is finished and plastic items are also soaking wet. If you do not choose a fast program, the door can open automatically. The machine then evaporates, but it is still not really dry inside. The drying result is considerably worse than our 10 year older machine.

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace our dated Kitchen Aid washer.
Comments (English): [ Pretty good ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace our dated Kitchen Aid washer. I pretty much bought this because of consumer reports reviews and other user reviews online. Overall, it does a good job. You put dishes in and they come out clean. I like how it shows a light on the floor that it's running. My Kitchen Aid had almost no signal that it was on and it was hard to tell if it was done or not. I also like the app. I get a phone notification when the dishes are done and then I go open it up to finish drying. I was a little disappointed that the dishes were a little wet even when using crystal dry. After about 10 cycles, there is still a "new" smell that is noticeable right when dishes are hot. It's a little chemical smelling so I hope it goes away soon. Some things I liked about my Kitchen aid better is that the drawers were smoother. When the front door is open just a little on the Kitchen aid, the bottom rack still slides nicely in and you can close the door. On this machine, if the door is a little up, the bottom rack will not go in. It will get stuck until you completely lower the door. Also, it's hard to prop the door open just a little to let it dry. This was easy on the Kitchen Aid. This door just wants to shut all the way or you have to leave it 1/2 open. The container that holds the detergent seems like it barely clicks closed. It works perfectly fine, but I do worry about it failing one day.

Sentence (English): I bought it after much deliberation due to arthritis in my fingers.
Comments (English): [ It's so good that I recommend it to people around me~! ^^b ] || ---------------- || I bought it after much deliberation due to arthritis in my fingers. Many people say that a dishwasher is better than nothing. Based on my experience using a built-in style 'large capacity' dishwasher for about 20 years, I only use it when my whole family gathers for holidays~ I bought a 6-person dishwasher with the intention of using it for every meal, but now I only run it once in the evening, so I can wash a lot of dishes! ^^ The installation was done by passing the water hose through the existing gas pipe hole, so no separate hole was needed. There is a difference of about 20 minutes in the operating time just by drying. Depending on the material, there are cases where moisture is not removed well, so I turn off the drying function and use natural drying. Plastic and wood that do not dry well are taken out immediately after washing and placed on a drying rack, and the rest of the dishes are almost completely dry with just a high-temperature wash + they dry quickly. At first, I used detergent by cutting it in half. But it was enough even if I cut it by 1/3 or 1/4~ The most satisfying part of using a dishwasher is. The glasses are washed so cleanly that they are sparkling clean~ It also removes all kinds of side dish smells~ I used it and liked it so much that I started promoting it to people around me~ When my sister moved recently, I gave her the same product as a gift to commemorate the move. My brother also bought one, so the whole family ended up using the \"Samsung BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person\"~ ^^ Even though it is for 6 people, it is bigger than I expected, so it takes up quite a lot of space. But the dishwasher is so effective that it is worth it. Of course, you have to use your fingers to put the dishes in one by one, but compared to washing the dishes while trying to wash them thoroughly, it is less stressful on your fingers. I am very satisfied~! There is a reason why everyone looks for Auntie Dishwasher~ ^^b -------------------- I hope this review was helpful. Thank you~ ^^

Of course, you have to use your fingers to put the dishes in one by one, but compared to washing the dishes while trying to wash them thoroughly, it is less stressful on your fingers. Comments (English): [ It's so good that I recommend it to people around me~! ^^b ] || ---------------- || I bought it after much deliberation due to arthritis in my fingers. Many people say that a dishwasher is better than nothing. Based on my experience using a built-in style 'large capacity' dishwasher for about 20 years, I only use it when my whole family gathers for holidays~ I bought a 6-person dishwasher with the intention of using it for every meal, but now I only run it once in the evening, so I can wash a lot of dishes! ^^ The installation was done by passing the water hose through the existing gas pipe hole, so no separate hole was needed. There is a difference of about 20 minutes in the operating time just by drying. Depending on the material, there are cases where moisture is not removed well, so I turn off the drying function and use natural drying. Plastic and wood that do not dry well are taken out immediately after washing and placed on a drying rack, and the rest of the dishes are almost completely dry with just a high-temperature wash + they dry quickly. At first, I used detergent by cutting it in half. But it was enough even if I cut it by 1/3 or 1/4~ The most satisfying part of using a dishwasher is. The glasses are washed so cleanly that they are sparkling clean~ It also removes all kinds of side dish smells~ I used it and liked it so much that I started promoting it to people around me~ When my sister moved recently, I gave her the same product as a gift to commemorate the move. My brother also bought one, so the whole family ended up using the \"Samsung BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person\"~ ^^ Even though it is for 6 people, it is bigger than I expected, so it takes up quite a lot of space. But the dishwasher is so effective that it is worth it. Of course, you have to use your fingers to put the dishes in one by one, but compared to washing the dishes while trying to wash them thoroughly, it is less stressful on your fingers. I am very satisfied~! There is a reason why everyone looks for Auntie Dishwasher~ ^^b -------------------- I hope this review was helpful. Thank you~ ^^

Sentence (English): This is a review of something I bought with my own money!
Comments (English): [ Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-Person ] || ---------------- || This is a review of something I bought with my own money! Reason for purchase: The existing 3-4 person dishwasher was too small for a two-person household who uses a lot of dishes and pots when cooking, so we ended up purchasing the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop 6-person dishwasher~! Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop 6-person Dishwasher Features: High-temperature direct water Upper and lower wing 3D water jet (Upper: 15 cm upper wing / Lower: 42.5 cm washing wing) Various customized courses, options (Standard, Powerful, Eco, Rapid, Total Sterilization) Automatic door opening drying Large-capacity folding basket User review: The installer contacted me the day before, and he was very kind and installed it neatly:) It says white, but it's a bit grayish~ It's also bigger than I thought! And I take out a lot of dishes and pots, and since it's a two-person family, it can fit plenty. There are also two spoon holders, so it's spacious~ However, the spoon holder is not fixed and keeps falling over without strength, which is a disadvantage. I cut the detergent into quarters and it seems perfect~ It's so convenient because you just have to put it in the detergent holder and press the button~! The standard mode takes a little over an hour, and it's louder than I thought; It's annoying when watching TV~ But I love that it automatically washes the dishes so well after I just do the first wash. The door opens automatically after the dishwasher finishes washing them, but once I left the door wide open, and another time I left it only as far as it opens automatically and opened it the next day. 11자로 세워서 아니고 엎어놓기. 엎기 직전으로 사선으로 기대 놓는다면 안씻기는 세제잔여 없음  전원은 잠깐터치 아니고 꾹 누르고 있으면 더잘됨 총평:  누가 우리집에와서 설거지만 해주고가는 느낌 (아이조아) 가격이 자꾸 치솟으니 빠르게 살수록  더 빨리 행복해질수 있다고 확신함!!  저는 하루에 2~3번은 돌림(방학크리) 적을땐 저녁에 1번 . 그냥 부담없이 자주돌림 ㅎㅎ  세상행복  요리를 즐겨하며 자주하고 베이킹도 하고있고 그릇도 반찬통 아니고 접시에 하나하나 담아주는 엄마임 4인가족인데 식세기 크기 작다고 안느끼며 담에 더 큰거사볼까~ 정도밖에는 별생각이 안들고 부담없이 아주아주 잘쓰고 있어요 사보면 \'왜 이제샀지?\' 할것임 함께 손목 아끼고 허리아끼고 목디스크 보호해보아요. 이상 유튜브로 공부하고 읽은후기와 직접써본후기 종합해서 써보았어요.  도움되시길바래요 이상 내돈내산리뷰 끝~~~

Overall: I actually thought, "Why do I need a dishwasher? Just wash the dishes by hand quickly. " Even though there was an LG dishwasher in my previous house, I didn't use it and just left it. But when I picked up trash in the neighborhood with the apartment residents and picked it up too passionately, my wrists hurt so much. I couldn't even wash the dishes and my wrists shook even when I tried to do something delicate. I regretted it. My wrist hurts so much that I can't do it. While looking for a dishwasher, I was worried about the capacity at first. There are 3-person, 6-person, and 12-person models. My younger sibling complained that the 3-person model was too small. However, I thought that it wouldn't be necessary for 12 people or more, and the size was too big. I wanted to use it by placing it on the sink. I wanted to use it without having to bend down. So while looking for a 6-person model, I thought it would be Samsung anyway, and I came across a Samsung dishwasher. I strangely liked Samsung. However, after installing it, I realized that it wasn't made by Samsung. I should have read the detailed information earlier. Two Samsung technicians came to install it together. And the dishwasher is quite large. I was surprised because it was bigger than I thought when it was first delivered. It's the size of a 12-person dishwasher cut in half. It can hold a frying pan. When I use it, I save up a day's worth and wash the dishes at once. It might be because my house doesn't produce much dishes, but... It's perfect for home use. I'm using it with great satisfaction. Buy it when the price is low. I realized this time why it's called the top 3 aunts in Korea. I think it's much better to have a dryer and a dishwasher. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Please consider my personal opinion on the product as a reference, and remember that the judgment and decision are entirely up to the buyer :) Let's all be smart consumers by sharing the review~ If it was helpful, please click 'Helpful'. Comments (Original): [ 식세기를 왜 진작 안샀는지 정말 남편보다 좋아요. ] || ---------------- || #솔직후기 #내돈내산  구매시 나에게도 여러분에게도 도움이 되기를 바라며 후기 시작합니다. :) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ◆제품이름:  삼성전자 BESPOKE 식기세척기 카운터탑 6인용, DW30A3030CE(화이트), 방문설치 ◆제품용량: 6인용,  ◆제품무게: 21.5KG ◆구입가격:32만원대  장바구니 담아두고 종종 보다보면 훅내릴때 있음 마지노선 정해두고  적당히 내려가면 바로 구입하세용!!  ◆장점:  편해요!!! 말해뭐해!! 세척잘함! ◆단점: 처음보다 점점 소음이 커지는 듯한 느낌???? ◆총평:  전 사실 \' 식기세척기가 뭐가 필요해, 그냥 손으로 금방 설거지하면 돼지.!!!!\' 라고 생각했었어요. 심지어 예전에 살던집에는 LG식세기가 있었음에도 불구하고 사용하지 않고 그냥 뒀었어요.  그런데 제가 동네 쓰레기 줍기를 아파트주민들과 함께 하다가 너무 열정으로 주웠는지 손목이 너무 아픈거예요. 설거지도 못하고 조금만 섬세한 작업하려고 해도 손목이 덜덜덜 떨리고 ㅜㅜ 적당히 할걸.. 후회했죠.  손목이 너무 너무 아파서 안돼겠다. 식세기 사야지 하고 찾아보던 와중에 처음에는 용량이 고민됐었어요. 3인용, 6인용, 12인용이상 다양하더라고요. 동생네는 3인용인데 너무 작다고 불평하더라고요. 그렇다고 3식구인데 12인이상까지는 필요없을 것 같았고 크기도 너무 커지고요. 전 싱크대에 올려두고 사용하고 싶었거든요. 허리 숙일 필요없이 쓰고 싶었어요.  그래서 6인용 제품으로 알아보던 와중에 그래도 삼성이지 하면서 삼성식세기를 보게 되었고요. 전 이상하게 삼성이 좋더라구요.  그런데 이 제품은 다 설치하고 보니 삼성에서 만든건 아니더라구요. ㅋㅋㅋ 진작 상세내용좀 읽어 볼걸  ㅎㅎㅎ  배송은 삼성기사님 2분이 함께 오셔서 설치해주셨어요. 그리고 식세기가 상당히 큽니다. 처음배송왔을 때 생각했던 크기보다 커서 깜짝 놀랐어요. 12인용 식세기 반절 잘라놓은것 같은 크기랍니다. 후라이팬 충분히 들어가고요. 저는 사용할 때 하루치 모아뒀다가 한번에 설거지 돌려요. 저희집이 나오는 설거지 양이 적어서 그럴지도 모르지만요. 집에서 쓰기엔 정말 딱입니다. 아주 만족하면서 사용하고 있어요. 가격도 저렴할 때 노려서 구입하세요. 왜 대한민국 3대이모라고 하는지 이번에 확실히 깨달았어요. 전 건조기랑 식세기는 있는게 훨씬 좋다고 생각합니다.  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 제품에 대한 제 개인적인 의견은 참고로 해주시고 판단과 결정은 어디까지나 구매자의 몫이라는 점 기억해 주세요 :)  리뷰공유해서 모두들 똑똑한 소비하자구요~ㅎㅎ  도움이 되셨다면 '도움이 돼요' 눌러주시면 리뷰쓰는 저도 신명납니다 ㅎㅎ 신나고 행복한 하루 보내세요~♡

Overall: I actually thought, "Why do I need a dishwasher? Just wash the dishes by hand quickly. " Even though there was an LG dishwasher in my previous house, I didn't use it and just left it. But when I picked up trash in the neighborhood with the apartment residents and picked it up too passionately, my wrists hurt so much. I couldn't even wash the dishes and my wrists shook even when I tried to do something delicate. I regretted it. My wrist hurts so much that I can't do it. While looking for a dishwasher, I was worried about the capacity at first. There are 3-person, 6-person, and 12-person models. My younger sibling complained that the 3-person model was too small. However, I thought that it wouldn't be necessary for 12 people or more, and the size was too big. I wanted to use it by placing it on the sink. I wanted to use it without having to bend down. So while looking for a 6-person model, I thought it would be Samsung anyway, and I came across a Samsung dishwasher. I strangely liked Samsung. However, after installing it, I realized that it wasn't made by Samsung. I should have read the detailed information earlier. Two Samsung technicians came to install it together. And the dishwasher is quite large. I was surprised because it was bigger than I thought when it was first delivered. It's the size of a 12-person dishwasher cut in half. It can hold a frying pan. When I use it, I save up a day's worth and wash the dishes at once. It might be because my house doesn't produce much dishes, but... It's perfect for home use. I'm using it with great satisfaction. Buy it when the price is low. I realized this time why it's called the top 3 aunts in Korea. Except for the water pooling in the bowl because of the grooves, it's really clean itself. Thanks to the LG 14-person dishwasher, I can now finish in one day what I used to do 3 times. I'm so happy. The existing 6-person dishwasher will now go to its little brother~!

Sentence (English): I bought this LG dishwasher with my own money.
Comments (English): I bought this LG dishwasher with my own money. Model: DUE6BGL2. Purchase date: January 8, 2025. Installation date: January 10, 2025. Installed in the morning! I used to use a Samsung dishwasher for 6 people, which was plenty, but I cut down on delivery and started eating more at home, so the dishes piled up at an incredible rate. I used this 6-person dishwasher for about 10 months, and it started running three times a day, which meant more and more people in the kitchen. I thought it couldn't be helped, so I started searching for a dishwasher two months ago. I saw prices starting at 1.2 million won, but with a credit card discount, it dropped to 1.1 million won. I also saw it around Christmas and New Year's, but I missed it when it dropped to 1.03 million won elsewhere, so I was keeping an eye on Coupang. Wow! It was 1.07 million won, with a 100,000 won discount with a Kookmin Card. Coupon discount: 40,000 won. I came here through another site and received a 1.5% reward point, so my total purchase amount was 1.06 million won. There's still a bit more to come. The price will drop further when the 2025 model comes out, but considering the time it would take to rotate it three times, I calculated it and bought it! The technician kindly offered to remove the existing 6-seater dresser for free. However, I ended up having to remodel the cabinet, so the renovation cost was a bit high. Still, I got a small dresser! After listening to the technician's explanation, I put everything back in, including yesterday's dresser. Wow, it all fit in at once. I even had to do the larvae before putting them in. They warned me that food scraps could cause odors during drying. I adjusted the height to three levels so everything fits evenly, and voila! Now I can spend less time in the kitchen, which is great. Ah! I was debating between the 12-seater and the 14-seater, but just buy the 14-seater! There's a reason it's ranked #2 on Coupang~^^. Day 2. On the second day, I tried the tablet version instead of the liquid version. The tablet was a bit too much detergent for the previous 6-person dishwasher, but it's perfect for the 14-person dishwasher. Look at that light. I also uploaded a video of the hot air mode. Except for the grooves in the bowl where water collects, it's really clean. Thanks to the LG 14-person dishwasher, I can now finish in one day what used to be 3 loads. It's so great. The previous 6-person dishwasher is now going to its little brother~!

I used this 6-person dishwasher for about 10 months, and it started running three times a day, which meant more and more people in the kitchen. I thought it couldn't be helped, so I started searching for a dishwasher two months ago. I saw prices starting at 1.2 million won, but with a credit card discount, it dropped to 1.1 million won. I also saw it around Christmas and New Year's, but I missed it when it dropped to 1.03 million won elsewhere, so I was keeping an eye on Coupang. Wow! It was 1.07 million won, with a 100,000 won discount with a Kookmin Card. Coupon discount: 40,000 won. I came here through another site and received a 1.5% reward point, so my total purchase amount was 1.06 million won. There's still a bit more to come. The price will drop further when the 2025 model comes out, but considering the time it would take to rotate it three times, I calculated it and bought it! The technician kindly offered to remove the existing 6-seater dresser for free. However, I ended up having to remodel the cabinet, so the renovation cost was a bit high. Still, I got a small dresser! After listening to the technician's explanation, I put everything back in, including yesterday's dresser. Wow, it all fit in at once. I even had to do the larvae before putting them in. They warned me that food scraps could cause odors during drying. I adjusted the height to three levels so everything fits evenly, and voila! Now I can spend less time in the kitchen, which is great. Ah! I was debating between the 12-seater and the 14-seater, but just buy the 14-seater! There's a reason it's ranked #2 on Coupang~^^. Day 2. On the second day, I tried the tablet version instead of the liquid version. The tablet was a bit too much detergent for the previous 6-person dishwasher, but it's perfect for the 14-person dishwasher. Look at that light. I also uploaded a video of the hot air mode. Except for the grooves in the bowl where water collects, it's really clean. Thanks to the LG 14-person dishwasher, I can now finish in one day what used to be 3 loads. It's so great. The previous 6-person dishwasher is now going to its little brother~!

Sentence (English): I am a huge fan of this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Flexible baskets, super drying, best results ] || ---------------- || I am a huge fan of this dishwasher. I always wanted a BSH dishwasher with zeolite drying after hearing so many positive things about this technology. I can definitely say: Bosch is not exaggerating when it comes to drying results. Everything is completely dry. Even plastic. No other manufacturer can compete with that. It is only a little weak on plastic in the eco program, but that is not a problem. If you want it drier, there is always the extra dry option, which you can even switch on permanently in the settings without pressing the button every time. The flexibility of the baskets is also worth mentioning, I can arrange both baskets however I want, and the option of only folding down every second folding spike on the high folding spikes in the lower basket is also great. And in the upper basket I can also fold down all the spikes, so I can load the dishwasher very flexibly. It is also very quiet and the cleaning results are great even in the short program. Running times are also good, even without SpeedPerfect. It's also great that the controls are not on the visible front, but on the top of the door like on a built-in dishwasher. It just looks good. I only recommend dishwashers from Bosch/Siemens household appliances to all of my friends and acquaintances.
Comments (Original): [ Flexible Körbe, super Trocknung, beste Ergebnisse ] || ---------------- || Ich bin ein großer Fan dieses Geschirrspülers. Ich wollte schon immer einmal einen BSH-Geschirrspüler mit Zeolith-Trocknung, nachdem ich so viel Positives über diese Technologie gehört habe. Ich kann definitiv sagen: Bosch übertreibt nicht, was die Trocknungsergebnisse angeht. Alles restlos trocken. Auch Kunststoff. Dagegen kann kein anderer Hersteller ankommen. Nur im Eco-Programm schwächelt er etwas bei Kunststoff, aber das ist nicht schlimm. Wenn man es trockener haben möchte, gibt es ja immer noch die Extra-Trocken Option, die man in den Einstellungen sogar permanent anschalten kann, ohne jedes Mal die Taste zu drücken. Die Flexibilität der Körbe ist auch hervorzuheben, ich kann beide Körbe so gestalten, wie ich möchte, toll ist auch die Option, bei den hohen Klappstacheln im unteren Korb nur jede zweite Klappstachel umzuklappen. Und im oberen Korb kann ich auch alle Stacheln umklappen, sodass ich den Geschirrspüler ganz flexibel beladen kann. Dazu ist er noch sehr leise und die Reinigungsergebnisse sind selbst im Kurzprogramm super. Laufzeiten sind auch gut, auch ohne SpeedPerfect. Toll ist auch, dass die Bedienelemente nicht vorne an der sichtbaren Front sind, sondern wie bei einem Einbau-Geschirrspüler auf der Oberseite der Tür. Sieht einfach gut aus.Ich empfehle jedem in meinem Freundes- und Bekanntenkreis nur noch Geschirrspüler von Bosch/Siemens-Hausgeräte.

Sentence (English): I purchased this because of the Wirecutter recommendation.
Comments (English): I purchased this because of the Wirecutter recommendation. After using this a month, I'll agree it washes well. I'm not thrilled with it, for several reasons: 1. The baskets seem a little flimsy, and they have tine spacing that seem less friendly than our previous Kitchen Aid (admittedly a more deluxe version than this Bosch). So fewer dishes and such can be put in for each load. 2. The controls on the front panel are limited. If you want full control), like delayed start, you have to use the app, which didn't seem friendly to set up and use ( and I'm a technical person). I'm really annoyed that you need an app. I really would rather pay more and be able to do everything from the panel. Who wants to start a dishwasher remotely anyway? Useless complication. 3. The chassis is made of a soft plastic. While it is nice that the unit is lighter weight, It's not as robust for installation. The manual warns about techniques to make connections so as to not bend or damage things as a result. Also, the bottom cosmetic cover panel requires the brackets to be pushed into the chassis slots. This is, by design, an interference fit, and the soft chassis has ridges (by design) which start deforming as the brackets are installed. This deformation gets bigger as you push in the brackets and soon you find that you cannot push them in all the way and the brackets themselves start bending because they are not stiff enough. This is a poor design. I gave up at installation and I have yet to figure out how to fix this. 4. Be wary of the required installation height. I have seen two different numbers in the literature, and in reality it might need more than either. Despite my opening being OK by my measurement, there is an exposed plastic piece on the top that interfered with my cabinet that required modification to the cabinet in order to get the unit into the opening. 5. Oh, not the dishwasher's issue, but rather Home Depot: I had removed the old dishwasher and old hoses and shut of the water. The installers arrived and looked at my water shut off valve, which was dripping, and said they could not do the scheduled installation because of company policy and they were not plumbers so they could not replace it. They had to reschedule instead. I think they should warn customers ahead of time that this was the case! They said this happened often. This is unnecessary hassle. So I had to pay a plumber and then I did the installation myself. I have been removing and repairing my old dishwasher for years, so that didn't scare me, but it was just the added complication that I didn't want to have to spend time on.

The baskets seem a little flimsy, and they have tine spacing that seem less friendly than our previous Kitchen Aid (admittedly a more deluxe version than this Bosch). So fewer dishes and such can be put in for each load. 2. The controls on the front panel are limited. If you want full control), like delayed start, you have to use the app, which didn't seem friendly to set up and use ( and I'm a technical person). I'm really annoyed that you need an app. I really would rather pay more and be able to do everything from the panel. Who wants to start a dishwasher remotely anyway? Useless complication. 3. The chassis is made of a soft plastic. While it is nice that the unit is lighter weight, It's not as robust for installation. The manual warns about techniques to make connections so as to not bend or damage things as a result. Also, the bottom cosmetic cover panel requires the brackets to be pushed into the chassis slots. This is, by design, an interference fit, and the soft chassis has ridges (by design) which start deforming as the brackets are installed. This deformation gets bigger as you push in the brackets and soon you find that you cannot push them in all the way and the brackets themselves start bending because they are not stiff enough. This is a poor design. I gave up at installation and I have yet to figure out how to fix this. 4. Be wary of the required installation height. I have seen two different numbers in the literature, and in reality it might need more than either. Despite my opening being OK by my measurement, there is an exposed plastic piece on the top that interfered with my cabinet that required modification to the cabinet in order to get the unit into the opening. 5. Oh, not the dishwasher's issue, but rather Home Depot: I had removed the old dishwasher and old hoses and shut of the water. The installers arrived and looked at my water shut off valve, which was dripping, and said they could not do the scheduled installation because of company policy and they were not plumbers so they could not replace it. They had to reschedule instead. I think they should warn customers ahead of time that this was the case! They said this happened often. This is unnecessary hassle. So I had to pay a plumber and then I did the installation myself. I have been removing and repairing my old dishwasher for years, so that didn't scare me, but it was just the added complication that I didn't want to have to spend time on.

This is, by design, an interference fit, and the soft chassis has ridges (by design) which start deforming as the brackets are installed.  This deformation gets bigger as you push in the brackets and soon you find that you cannot push them in all the way and the brackets themselves start bending because they are not stiff enough. This is a poor design.  I gave up at installation and I have yet to figure out how to fix this. 4.  Be wary of the required installation height. I have seen two different numbers in the literature, and in reality it might need more than either. Despite my opening being OK by my measurement,  there is an exposed plastic piece on the top that interfered with my cabinet that required modification to the cabinet in order to get the unit into the opening. 5. Oh, not the dishwasher’s issue, but rather Home Depot:  I had removed the old dishwasher and old hoses and shut of the water. The installers arrived and looked at my water shut off valve, which was dripping, and said they could not do the scheduled installation because of company policy and they were not plumbers so they could not replace it.  They had to reschedule instead.  I think they should warn customers ahead of time that this was the case!  They said this happened often. This is unnecessary hassle. So I had to pay a plumber and then I did the installation myself.  I have been removing and repairing my old dishwasher for years, so that didn’t scare me, but it was just the added complication that I didn’t want to have to spend time on.

Comments (English): [ DO NOT PURCHASE THIS!  ] || ---------------- || Avoid this dishwasher! Purchased in June 2022. Was delighted with it until about August 2024. Then it started throwing the FTD (failure to drain) code even though there was no water in it. Paid the fee for an eval and was told to unplug it for a couple days to reset the computer. So we did. After numerous rounds of doing so, which added up to weeks of non-use, we decided to call for a GE repair appointment. 5 days before paying for that eval, the dishwasher started working again. Cancelled the appointment with the service person. It worked fine, no issues, until December. We attempted the cycles of unplugging for days and reattempting until, in early January 2025, it just started working again. Which brings us to last night. I put in a load and went to bed. Woke up this morning to find my kitchen smelling like burnt rubber and the dishwasher throwing the FTD code and the drain motor running constantly, possibly all night judging by the smell. I clearly cannot attempt to use it again. I'm beyond angry that I paid hundreds of dollars for broke after just 26 months. I'm even more frustrated that the GE enterprise thinks this is acceptable. I will NEVER purchase another GE product again. I'm disgusted that a company that has been around for decades and used to be one of a good name and standing within the appliance world deems this to be acceptable. I will share my story with anyone who will listen in the hopes of turning more away from this line of appliances.

Sentence (English): I used to use a dishwasher, but I couldn't use it when I moved.
Comments (English): [ I used to use a dishwasher, but when I moved ] || ---------------- || I used to use a dishwasher, but I couldn't use it when I moved. I didn't feel much inconvenience because there weren't many dishes, but I knew that the pre-washing, detergent, and rinsing stages took quite a bit of time, so I felt it was a waste of time. I could run the dishwasher and do other things. I bought it right away. What I liked most was that the installer made the sink to my liking. Usually, if there's 20cm left, it's almost unusable, but he made it so that the inside was wide by closing the door. It cost extra, but I appreciate that he did it carefully from the consumer's perspective. The installer is Team Leader Lee Jeong-woo. I haven't used it yet, but I believe it will work well and I will leave a review after a month.

Comments (English): Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-Place Capacity, White, DW30CB300CW0, On-site Installation. Motivation for Purchase. I was looking for a compact model that would save space for using a dishwasher. I chose the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher because its 6-place capacity makes it suitable for small homes or apartments, and I decided to purchase it because the white color seemed to match my kitchen interior well. Additionally, the reliability of the Samsung brand also had a significant influence on my decision. Details. The Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher DW30CB300CW0 is a 6-place capacity dishwasher that provides a capacity to wash 6 servings of dishes at once. Designed as a countertop unit, this product does not take up a section of the kitchen but allows for efficient utilization of existing kitchen space. The white color blends well with any kitchen, giving a clean and sophisticated feel. It is equipped with various washing programs, offering excellent washing efficiency. Furthermore, an on-site installation service is included, making the initial setup easy and hassle-free. How to Use. The dishwasher is simple to use. Simply place the dishes inside the dishwasher, select your desired wash mode, and press the start button. The product offers various wash options, allowing you to choose the program that best suits your needs, ranging from standard washing to powerful stain removal. It is recommended to clean the filter after use, and once the wash is complete, simply remove the dishes and organize them. After installation, only basic maintenance and checking the wash status are required. Advantages of Practical Use: The biggest advantages are space saving and efficiency. With a capacity suitable for 6-place settings, it is sufficient for even small households, allowing you to save kitchen space while still having washing capabilities. Thanks to the various wash programs, it is very convenient to be able to wash dishes according to their condition and level of soiling. The washing performance is also excellent, allowing you to clean dishes more thoroughly than by hand. Additionally, installation is very simple as a visit service is included, and true to Samsung Electronics' reputation, it boasts excellent durability. Disadvantages: A drawback is that the interior of the dishwasher is narrower than expected, making it difficult to wash large dishes or pots. Also, there may be some noise during the wash cycle, which could be inconvenient for those who prefer a quiet environment. Since limescale may remain after the initial wash following installation, it is necessary to clean it by running a few empty washes. Intention to Repurchase: Yes. I am satisfied because it is convenient to use and offers excellent space efficiency. The performance and design are so outstanding that I would recommend it to first-time dishwashers. I intend to repurchase. One-line Review: A space-saving, efficient 6-place setting dishwasher! If my review was helpful, please give it a "Helpful" :)

Sentence (English): I purchased this because of the Wirecutter recommendation.
Comments (English): I purchased this because of the Wirecutter recommendation. After using this a month, I'll agree it washes well. I'm not thrilled with it, for several reasons:. 1. The baskets seem a little flimsy, and they have tine spacing that seem less friendly than our previous Kitchen Aid (admittedly a more deluxe version than this Bosch). So fewer dishes and such can be put in for each load. 2. The controls on the front panel are limited. If you want full control), like delayed start, you have to use the app, which didn't seem friendly to set up and use ( and I'm a technical person). I'm really annoyed that you need an app. I really would rather pay more and be able to do everything from the panel. Who wants to start a dishwasher remotely anyway? Useless complication. 3. The chassis is made of a soft plastic. While it is nice that the unit is lighter weight, It's not as robust for installation. The manual warns about techniques to make connections so as to not bend or damage things as a result. Also, the bottom cosmetic cover panel requires the brackets to be pushed into the chassis slots. This is, by design, an interference fit, and the soft chassis has ridges (by design) which start deforming as the brackets are installed. This deformation gets bigger as you push in the brackets and soon you find that you cannot push them in all the way and the brackets themselves start bending because they are not stiff enough. This is a poor design. I gave up at installation and I have yet to figure out how to fix this. 4. Be wary of the required installation height. I have seen two different numbers in the literature, and in reality it might need more than either. Despite my opening being OK by my measurement, there is an exposed plastic piece on the top that interfered with my cabinet that required modification to the cabinet in order to get the unit into the opening. 5. Oh, not the dishwasher's issue, but rather Home Depot: I had removed the old dishwasher and old hoses and shut of the water. The installers arrived and looked at my water shut off valve, which was dripping, and said they could not do the scheduled installation because of company policy and they were not plumbers so they could not replace it. They had to reschedule instead. I think they should warn customers ahead of time that this was the case! They said this happened often. This is unnecessary hassle. So I had to pay a plumber and then I did the installation myself. I have been removing and repairing my old dishwasher for years, so that didn't scare me, but it was just the added complication that I didn't want to have to spend time on.

So fewer dishes and such can be put in for each load. 2. The controls on the front panel are limited. If you want full control), like delayed start, you have to use the app, which didn't seem friendly to set up and use ( and I'm a technical person). I'm really annoyed that you need an app. I really would rather pay more and be able to do everything from the panel. Who wants to start a dishwasher remotely anyway? Useless complication. 3. The chassis is made of a soft plastic. While it is nice that the unit is lighter weight, It's not as robust for installation. The manual warns about techniques to make connections so as to not bend or damage things as a result. Also, the bottom cosmetic cover panel requires the brackets to be pushed into the chassis slots. This is, by design, an interference fit, and the soft chassis has ridges (by design) which start deforming as the brackets are installed. This deformation gets bigger as you push in the brackets and soon you find that you cannot push them in all the way and the brackets themselves start bending because they are not stiff enough. This is a poor design. I gave up at installation and I have yet to figure out how to fix this. 4. Be wary of the required installation height. I have seen two different numbers in the literature, and in reality it might need more than either. Despite my opening being OK by my measurement, there is an exposed plastic piece on the top that interfered with my cabinet that required modification to the cabinet in order to get the unit into the opening. 5. Oh, not the dishwasher's issue, but rather Home Depot: I had removed the old dishwasher and old hoses and shut of the water. The installers arrived and looked at my water shut off valve, which was dripping, and said they could not do the scheduled installation because of company policy and they were not plumbers so they could not replace it. They had to reschedule instead. I think they should warn customers ahead of time that this was the case! They said this happened often. This is unnecessary hassle. So I had to pay a plumber and then I did the installation myself. I have been removing and repairing my old dishwasher for years, so that didn't scare me, but it was just the added complication that I didn't want to have to spend time on.

Sentence (English): BEWARE Samsung dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ BEWARE Samsung dishwashers ] || ---------------- || BEWARE Samsung dishwashers. Mine leaks like a sieve after just 3 years. 6 months in I'd have rated it 5 star. Then the leaks started. First, water flowed out onto my new flooring but the machine did not stop. Later, the LS warning would flash and stop the machine. To restart required pulling the machine out from under the cabinet -- which we've done twice. Most recently, I noticed that the insulation in the door is saturated (water wicked up, I believe). All this in a household that only runs about four loads of dishes per week and rinses everything first.Also, service is poor. Calls to the 1-800 number get you another 1-800 number to the vendor that was hired to do the installation (and they don't honor the SS warranty). If you can't fix the issue yourself, the alternative is costly. My third issue (admittedly a pet peeve of mine) is that this dishwasher and also the Samsung fridge we purchased at the same time, is programmed to link up with your home wifi network even if you are old school enough to want it to do one job: wash dishes. Makes one wonder what spyware could be activating. Today I'm removing it and buying another brand.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher was delivered on time and appeared to be in good shape upon delivery.
Comments (English): The dishwasher was delivered on time and appeared to be in good shape upon delivery. Delivery folks were professional and friendly. It was delivered just before the holidays so we didn't unpackage and install it until about 3 weeks after delivery. Installation seemed straightforward. However when we attempted to run it through its first cycle per instructions, it would not fill with water or run. The control panel lit up and allowed entering cycle options but would not fill or start! After many, many hours of frustration and trying to figure the problem and a lot of internet research, we discovered that it was apparently and inexplicably shipped in “display mode” from the factory. None of this is hinted at or discussed in the startup or operating instructions. You can operate the controls but the washer won't actually start! Once we changed the mode it started filling and appeared to be working as designed. Our celebration was short lived. At 43 minutes into the first cycle the circuit breaker in the electrical panel tripped shutting it down. We reset breaker and restarted a new washcycle. Again at precisely 43 minutes into cycle it tripped the circuit breaker. Several more attempts and same result…circuit breaker trips at 43 minutes into cycle. It appeared that there was a defect somewhere in the washer. We had purchased the 5-year Allstate protection plan. But when I contacted them I was told it appeared to be defective upon delivery and was thus not covered by the plan and that I had to contact the retailer or the manufacturer. I called home depot and was told that we could not return it to them for replacement because their policy says an appliance has to be returned within 48 hours! They said the 5-warranty plan would also not kick in until the 1-year manufacturer's warranty had expired. I was instructed to call GE for service under their warranty. We have now been waiting for about 10 days for GE to schedule an appointment with us for service to see if they can repair this brand new dishwasher it or if it needs to be replaced! So, no. Not very happy at all with this purchase so far. Maybe I will update this review if and when we actually get some service from GE and a working dishwasher.

The control panel lit up and allowed entering cycle options but would not fill or start!  After many, many hours of frustration and trying to figure the problem and a lot of internet research, we discovered that it was apparently and inexplicably shipped in “display mode” from the factory.  None of this is hinted at or discussed in the startup or operating instructions.  You can operate the controls but the washer won’t actually start!  Once we changed the mode it started filling and appeared to be working as designed.  Our celebration was short lived.  At 43 minutes into the first cycle the circuit breaker in the electrical panel tripped shutting it down.  We reset breaker and restarted a new washcycle.  Again at precisely 43 minutes into cycle it tripped the circuit breaker.  Several more attempts and same result…circuit breaker trips at 43 minutes into cycle. It appeared that there was a defect somewhere in the washer.  We had purchased the 5-year Allstate protection plan. But when I contacted them I was told it appeared to be defective upon delivery and was thus not covered by the plan and that I had to contact the retailer or the manufacturer. I called home depot and was told that we could not return it to them for replacement because their policy says an appliance has to be returned within 48 hours!  They said the 5-warranty plan would also not kick in until the 1-year manufacturer’s warranty had expired.  I was instructed to call GE for service under their warranty.  We have now been waiting for about 10 days for GE to schedule an appointment with us for service to see if they can repair this brand new dishwasher it or if it needs to be replaced! So, no.  Not very happy at all with this purchase so far.  Maybe I will update this review if and when we actually get some service from GE and a working dishwasher.

However when we attempted to run it through its first cycle per instructions, it would not fill with water or run. The control panel lit up and allowed entering cycle options but would not fill or start!  After many, many hours of frustration and trying to figure the problem and a lot of internet research, we discovered that it was apparently and inexplicably shipped in “display mode” from the factory.  None of this is hinted at or discussed in the startup or operating instructions.  You can operate the controls but the washer won’t actually start!  Once we changed the mode it started filling and appeared to be working as designed.  Our celebration was short lived.  At 43 minutes into the first cycle the circuit breaker in the electrical panel tripped shutting it down.  We reset breaker and restarted a new washcycle.  Again at precisely 43 minutes into cycle it tripped the circuit breaker.  Several more attempts and same result…circuit breaker trips at 43 minutes into cycle. It appeared that there was a defect somewhere in the washer.  We had purchased the 5-year Allstate protection plan. But when I contacted them I was told it appeared to be defective upon delivery and was thus not covered by the plan and that I had to contact the retailer or the manufacturer. I called home depot and was told that we could not return it to them for replacement because their policy says an appliance has to be returned within 48 hours!  They said the 5-warranty plan would also not kick in until the 1-year manufacturer’s warranty had expired.  I was instructed to call GE for service under their warranty.  We have now been waiting for about 10 days for GE to schedule an appointment with us for service to see if they can repair this brand new dishwasher it or if it needs to be replaced! So, no.  Not very happy at all with this purchase so far.  Maybe I will update this review if and when we actually get some service from GE and a working dishwasher.

However when we attempted to run it through its first cycle per instructions, it would not fill with water or run. The control panel lit up and allowed entering cycle options but would not fill or start!  After many, many hours of frustration and trying to figure the problem and a lot of internet research, we discovered that it was apparently and inexplicably shipped in “display mode” from the factory.  None of this is hinted at or discussed in the startup or operating instructions.  You can operate the controls but the washer won’t actually start!  Once we changed the mode it started filling and appeared to be working as designed.  Our celebration was short lived.  At 43 minutes into the first cycle the circuit breaker in the electrical panel tripped shutting it down.  We reset breaker and restarted a new washcycle.  Again at precisely 43 minutes into cycle it tripped the circuit breaker.  Several more attempts and same result…circuit breaker trips at 43 minutes into cycle. It appeared that there was a defect somewhere in the washer.  We had purchased the 5-year Allstate protection plan. But when I contacted them I was told it appeared to be defective upon delivery and was thus not covered by the plan and that I had to contact the retailer or the manufacturer. I called home depot and was told that we could not return it to them for replacement because their policy says an appliance has to be returned within 48 hours!  They said the 5-warranty plan would also not kick in until the 1-year manufacturer’s warranty had expired.  I was instructed to call GE for service under their warranty.  We have now been waiting for about 10 days for GE to schedule an appointment with us for service to see if they can repair this brand new dishwasher it or if it needs to be replaced! So, no.  Not very happy at all with this purchase so far.  Maybe I will update this review if and when we actually get some service from GE and a working dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher does a great job.

They refunded that part of the service, and I had to find another independent installer to come out and do the job (which he did with ease).

Comments (English): [ Fits a ton of dishes, but not as quiet as hoped. ] || ---------------- || Overall, this has been a great replacement for our 10 year old Whirlpool. It looks great with our other appliances, even though they're different brands. The top rack is great for flatware, spatulas, small lids, etc. We can fit so much more into this model compared to the old one. The adjustable middle rack is helpful at times. We don't even really need the utensil basket at the bottom, so I kind of wish there were more tines instead of the spot where the basket sits. I gave it 4 stars mostly because of the noise level. Our old machine was a 52 dBA and this one frankly isn't much quieter, if any. Still, it's not so loud that it's a problem, it's just that when you pay more money for quieter machines, you expect to notice a difference.

Sentence (English): Bought our condo a few years ago and it came with a cheap LG washer.
Comments (English): [ A godsend ] || ---------------- || Bought our condo a few years ago and it came with a cheap LG washer. The last year it got so bad that it required replacement. We bought this washer from Costco having heard about how great the Bosch brand is, and couldn't be happier with it. I was worried about the noise as it had the same DB rating as our old LG, but this washer is so quiet and I don't mind running it during the day now. I love the app connection so I can know when it's done running and monitor it remotely. I will say - it doesn't dry very well unless you turn on the "extra dry" setting which takes away some of its energy efficiency. Also, it requires an electrical plug to turn on, so if you don't have one easily accessible, you may have to pay to have one installed.

Sentence (English): We got the 500 series because we wanted the auto-air feature.
Comments (English): [ Bosch knowingly shipped an unfinished product ] || ---------------- || We got the 500 series because we wanted the auto-air feature. Dishwasher gets installed, we run it with auto-air, it doesn't open. After spending hours trying to adjust the leveling, etc, we call out a tech for a warranty repair. They come by, look at the dishwasher for 5 minutes, call Bosch, then tell us "yeah, auto-air doesn't work on these models yet, there will be a software update sometime in the next 4 months to fix it". So now we are forced to connect our dishwasher to the internet, and just deal with not having the main feature that is the selling point of this model, hoping that Bosch decides to enable it at some point in the future. If there were a lemon law for appliances instead of cars, we'd make them take it back. Aside from the above, the dishwasher is very quiet and does a great job of washing dishes, aside from the above problem. Hence two stars instead of one.

Sentence (English): I've had many dishwashers - GE, Kenmore, Whirlpool, Maytag in that order.
Comments (English): [ Love this too! ] || ---------------- || I've had many dishwashers - GE, Kenmore, Whirlpool, Maytag in that order. My last one they hauled away (Maytag) was just awful. So I decided to go with GE products again because I heard they improved. this dishwasher has the panel on top and I went with a handle on the door because that recessed handle sucked if somebody didn't clean their hand and you touched it next (think mashed potatoes LOL). I like the 3rd level for spatulas, keurig tray, etc and I like the extra jets for silverware etc. My dishes came out sparkling and clean and this dishwasher was the quietest I've ever had. I was going to spend the money to fix it myself, and at the same time fix the leaky door seal, only to find out that the door seal is riveted to the door. This requires purchasing the entire interior door panel instead of a $20 replacement seal. At this point, I might as well buy a whole new dishwasher. I'm done with manufacturers that make short-lived, unrepairable, and unreliable products. It worked well and I liked it, but it should have lasted 3x longer than it did and I should be able to repair it without it costing as much as a new one. Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Suitable for one person. The buttons are uncomfortable. ] || ---------------- || This is my first time using a dishwasher. It's compact, so it's convenient to install on top of the sink. Installation is simple. Just connect the water tank, the dishwasher, the water supply pipe, and the drain pipe. However, I always find it inconvenient to add water to the water tank, so I bought a 26mm connector and connected it to the automatic water supply valve on the dishwasher and the water purifier pipe. Now, water is automatically supplied without having to add water every time, which is very convenient. So, I removed the lower water tank. I also connected the drain pipe to the drain pipe under the sink (T-shaped drain pipe purchased separately). The drain pipe is not visible at all in the sink, so it looks neat. The only inconvenience is that the drying time takes too long, so I just want to wash, but that function is not available. When the washing is finished, the door opens slightly and switches to the drying function automatically. It's a shame that there's no function to only wash when doing laundry.

Sentence (English): This is our first Asko dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good so far ] || ---------------- || This is our first Asko dishwasher. Compared with our older Miele, it cleans and dries more consistently on a quick wash cycle, and doesn't guzzle rinse aid (I welcome the adjuster there). We thought the cutlery drawer would be a pain but it's fine, especially as you can lift it out to empty. Packing it has been a learning curve, we haven't regretted the lack of adjustable height for the upper rack and the fold-down area at the bottom is great. For our needs the slots for crockery in both racks and the slots for cutlery up the top are all slightly too close together — we could fit more in if they were 20% more widely spaced — but we can live with this. We thought the touch-panel controls would be a pain and slow us down, but it responds consistently and well, and repeating the previous cycle is a simple two-touch process. If the touch-screen malfunctions out of warranty we will not be happy, but so far it's a good machine.

Comments (English): [ No customer service. It would be no stars if that was possible. ] || ---------------- || Under warranty. Dishwasher has a design fault. Drying is not happening at all. After booking service online with great difficulties, because of the faulty website and no one answers the phone, the repair person finally came on the 05/12/24. To repair the same fault under warranty that has been repaired last year. Repair men was nice and said he will be back in two weeks after he gets new parts. Two weeks later, I get no reply SMS from AEG, that my booking is cancelled due to the parts unavailability. No further contact from AEG. I rang their 1300 number and waited for more than 30 min few times. Finally 07/01/25 I managed to get someone on the phone and my dishwasher FFB72600PM is currently booked in for a service with the parts needed on the 21/1/2025. Which is a subject to change depending on the parts availability. Under Australian Consumer Laws, an appliance under warranty has to be repaired within the reasonable time or the consumer is entitled to replacement or refund. I am sure that the reasonable time is way past for this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Very happy with our decision to purchase our Bosch 500 dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Absolutely worth the money. ] || ---------------- || Very happy with our decision to purchase our Bosch 500 dishwasher. I like the option to automatically open the dishwasher door to use less energy for drying dishes. The disheasher is very quiet. The racks are very well laid out and fit more dishes than the dishwasher we replaced in a similar price range. The quality of the wheels and racks is great and move very smoothly. The app connectivity is a nice bonus that we weren't really looking for. Overall, we are very pleased with the Bosch 500. One thing to be aware of if you are installing this yourself. Most dishwashers have empty space under them allowing flexibility of hoses and cords. This dishwasher does not have any space underneath, so you definitely need to route hoses and cords out to the side and directly into the cabinet.

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for 3.5 years, and it has been great and without issue.
Comments (English): [ Can\u2019t say I\u2019d recommend\u2026 ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for 3.5 years, and it has been great and without issue. that is, up until the holidays when it decided to no longer drain water. Based on the manual, the light indicator code indicates a clogged drain hose. We thought, ok that's an easy fix, so we disassembled the drain hose to relieve the clog. To our surprise, the hose was squeaky clean. After spending hours trying to get our dishwasher back in working order while hosting for the holidays (in a desperate attempt to avoid handwashing TONS of dishes), we were unable to fix it. So, we call Kitchenaid to find out they can't do anything because it's outside of warranty. Next, we called our appliance guy. He came out, and said it's likely the drain pump, motor and/or motherboard. However, doesn't actually do the repairs/full diagnostics, so we've been referred to another appliance company for an estimate. All of this to say, we're STILL without a dishwasher, STILL without a full diagnosis and repair estimate on a $1200 dishwasher that has only been lightly used by my husband and I in 3.5 years. Our previous dishwasher (of another commonly known brand) lasted much longer than this without issue — in fact, it was a workhorse that saw a lot more dishes than this dishwasher has. Extremely disappointed given we've been told it might be better to buy a new dishwasher with the cost of repairs and labor. I don't think it's unreasonable to expect a dishwasher to last more than 3.5 years….

Sentence (English): The dishwasher worked very well (and quietly! )
Comments (English): [ Too young to die! ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher worked very well (and quietly! ) for almost exactly three years but then started shutting down about halfway through the cycle usually with 23 to 27 minutes remaining. It seems the dishes are washed but not rinsed, though hard to tell. The panel goes completely dark. No error codes. sometimes it will shut down after only one or two minutes but usually goes about 30 whether short cycle, normal, one hour. Talked through the issue with a local repairman. He eliminated most common problems but found that models like this one seem to have a control board issue that results in these symptoms. A customer service rep today said the model had no known issues, however, and recommended having local repairman replace the part. I'm concerned that replacing a part that seems to have frequent problems may be a waste of money. Our repairman was surprised that such a new machine was failing, noting it was “too young to die.”

The light inside is a nice extra feature.

Sentence (English): Bought this 100 series to replace a 20 year old Bosch 100 Series.
Comments (English): [ Replacement Bosch ] || ---------------- || Bought this 100 series to replace a 20 year old Bosch 100 Series. Somewhat disappointed due to it is actually louder than the 20 year model even though it is labeled 50 Db it is more like 53 Db. There is less insulating on the back side and underside of the tub. Second thing it does not dry the dishes (even on extra dry and sanitize modes) as well as the 20 yr old model. Also preferred the lower rack setup and silverware holder over the new model. Plus side it seems to do a better job at cleaning the dishes. I will be adding a 3/4 inch layer of rockwool around the tub to help quiet it down. Wish I could get Bosch to pay for the rockwool.

It's incredibly convenient for busy households, as you can get notifications when the cycle is complete or even start the dishwasher while you're out. This can be frustrating, especially if you're trying to load dishes, as the weight of the unbalanced door makes it less convenient to use without the added panel.

This model is the latest model that only has the lights and glide rails that I don't really need, so I waited for it to go on sale. I moved and installed it. ] || ---------------- || This is my first time using a dishwasher, so I bought it and studied the model number before buying it. This model is the latest model that only has the lights and glide rails that I don't really need, so I waited for it to go on sale. I bought it when it was cheap to install it after moving and installed it in about a month. Many people in my apartment have a problem with the width when installing the dishwasher, so they do it by constructing three cabinets at the same time (dishwasher space and remodeling two existing cabinets). I entrusted the construction work to a technician who had already received many compliments for his work. This technician also visited, thinking that the height would be right, but since there were porcelain tiles, he told me to cancel because the height was not enough. I barely persuaded him to raise the cabinet and if it didn't work out, I almost cut the countertop, but he raised the cabinet well and installed it well. The construction technician asked me to ask the LG technician if it was possible to install it at this height, so I called, but he said that it was not possible and that I had to raise the space more, so I told him that it would be okay if the body got scratched because of the height, so I just went ahead and installed it after many twists and turns. The actual installation was really hard, but when the LG technician called me on the morning of the installation day to set up the time, he said that the construction work would start at this time and that I should come after a certain time, and he kept saying things like why the construction work was taking so long and that it was wrong, and when he came, he kept saying that the construction work was crooked and that he would do this and that and how much I paid for it, and that the price was cheap, so he kept complaining about other things, and it was a bit uncomfortable to listen to. The basic explanation of the dishwasher was different from other reviews, and he only told me that the salt container is here (he didn't even touch the hardness kit because he just left), so I looked for it again myself. Anyway, it was really hard to install, but I'm very satisfied. I've been using it for a little over a month, and I've been using it so hard that I got a notification that it had been used 30 times and that I've been using it diligently, and I really don't get stressed out about cooking thanks to the dishwasher. Even if I have several cooking pots and frying pans, they all just go to the dishwasher, which is very convenient. I've often seen posts saying that the dishwasher smells fishy when used. It was fine at first, but then it suddenly smelled, so we used a different detergent besides frog, and then we started using frog again, and it was fine. Those of you who smell something, try changing the detergent or don't turn off the automatic storage mode (don't open the door wide) and dry it completely. Thinking about it now, if I had given up on the day of installation, my quality of life would have dropped significantly. I don't think I can ever go back to a life without a dishwasher. If it hadn't been for the LG installer, the dishwasher installation would have been perfect, but that's a bit of a shame. But since the installer was kind when I installed other LG appliances, I don't think other people need to worry about that.

I barely persuaded him to raise the cabinet and if it didn't work out, I almost cut the countertop, but he raised the cabinet well and installed it well. The construction technician asked me to ask the LG technician if it was possible to install it at this height, so I called, but he said that it was not possible and that I had to raise the space more, so I told him that it would be okay if the body got scratched because of the height, so I just went ahead and installed it after many twists and turns. The actual installation was really hard, but when the LG technician called me on the morning of the installation day to set up the time, he said that the construction work would start at this time and that I should come after a certain time, and he kept saying things like why the construction work was taking so long and that it was wrong, and when he came, he kept saying that the construction work was crooked and that he would do this and that and how much I paid for it, and that the price was cheap, so he kept complaining about other things, and it was a bit uncomfortable to listen to. Anyway, it was really hard to install, but I'm very satisfied. But since the installer was kind when I installed other LG appliances, I don't think other people need to worry about that.

Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || # My money, my country (I bought it myself and am leaving an honest review ~) My house is not structured so I am using a 6-person dishwasher. I have been using it well for over a year and I know that I really can't live without it, so I wanted to buy it for my in-laws and I thought about it and looked into it, and I bought a large capacity one for my mother's birthday this time. When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She was very satisfied. And the stainless steel that she had used for over 10 years had a lot of dirt on it, so she put it in the dishwasher once and it came out like new. She was very satisfied and said that it was easy to use. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used to say that the 6-person one was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It holds all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy the built-in 14-person one when I move later. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~!
