Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || # My money, my country (I bought it myself and am leaving an honest review ~) My house is not structured so I am using a 6-person dishwasher. I have been using it well for over a year and I know that I really can't live without it, so I wanted to buy it for my in-laws and I thought about it and looked into it, and I bought a large capacity one for my mother's birthday this time. When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She was very satisfied. And the stainless steel that she had used for over 10 years had a lot of dirt on it, so she put it in the dishwasher once and it came out like new. She was very satisfied and said that it was easy to use. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used to say that the 6-person one was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It holds all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy the built-in 14-person one when I move later. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~! Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || # My money, my country (I bought it myself and am leaving an honest review ~) My house is not structured so I am using a 6-person dishwasher. When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She was very satisfied. And the stainless steel that she had used for over 10 years had a lot of dirt on it, so she put it in the dishwasher once and it came out like new. She was very satisfied and said that it was easy to use. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used to say that the 6-person one was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It holds all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy the built-in 14-person one when I move later. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~! When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~! Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || # My money, my country (I bought it myself and am leaving an honest review ~) My house is not structured so I am using a 6-person dishwasher. I have been using it well for over a year and I know that I really can't live without it, so I wanted to buy it for my in-laws and I thought about it and looked into it, and I bought a large capacity one for my mother's birthday this time. When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She was very satisfied. And the stainless steel that she had used for over 10 years had a lot of dirt on it, so she put it in the dishwasher once and it came out like new. She was very satisfied and said that it was easy to use. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used to say that the 6-person one was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It holds all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy the built-in 14-person one when I move later. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~! Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || # My money, my country (I bought it myself and am leaving an honest review ~) My house is not structured so I am using a 6-person dishwasher. When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She was very satisfied. And the stainless steel that she had used for over 10 years had a lot of dirt on it, so she put it in the dishwasher once and it came out like new. She was very satisfied and said that it was easy to use. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used to say that the 6-person one was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It holds all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy the built-in 14-person one when I move later. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~! Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || # My money, my country (I bought it myself and am leaving an honest review ~) My house is not structured so I am using a 6-person dishwasher. When I was pregnant, my mother-in-law always made dinner and washed the dishes and really didn't let me into the kitchen, so I felt sorry and also felt bad for taking care of my first child, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly and bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was very kind. First, he visited and checked and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be installed right away. The heat from the dishwasher rises upwards and damages the induction. So, depending on the induction company, you can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and they said that you can buy a panel and install it after raising the induction ~ We went to the company I inquired and they said I only needed to space it out 3cm, so I bought it right away and installed it. I made an appointment with the technician to set up the installation, but he was so busy that he finished the installation late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening and fixed it, and finally installed the dishwasher. I think it took almost 3 hours. Thank you so much for your hard work. My mother-in-law was so happy that I worked hard for her! On days when there are a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. She was very satisfied. And the stainless steel that she had used for over 10 years had a lot of dirt on it, so she put it in the dishwasher once and it came out like new. She was very satisfied and said that it was easy to use. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life ~ I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used to say that the 6-person one was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It holds all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy the built-in 14-person one when I move later. It is so good. I understand why people use dishwashers. It adds satisfaction to satisfaction ~! My house is not well-organized, so I have been using a 6-person dishwasher, and I have been using it well for over a year. I know that I really can't live without it, so I wanted to buy one for my in-laws and I thought about it and looked into it, and I bought a large capacity one for my mother-in-law's birthday. Since I am pregnant, my mother-in-law always cooks dinner and washes the dishes and doesn't let me into the kitchen, so I feel sorry and I also feel sorry for taking care of my firstborn, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly without thinking, so I bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was so kind. First, he came to check and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be done right away. He said that the heat from the dishwasher rises and damages the induction. So, he said that each induction company can raise the height by 2 to 15 cm, and that it was possible to buy a panel and install it after raising the induction. When we asked the company, they said we only needed to raise the height by 3 cm. After purchasing it and installing it, we made an appointment with the technician, but he was very busy. The installation was done late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening, fixed it, and barely managed to install the dishwasher. It took almost 3 hours. He worked so hard and was so grateful. My mother was so happy that he put in so much effort! On days when we have a lot of guests, it would take over an hour to wash the dishes once, so my mother used to have a hard time, but after using the dishwasher this time, she can have tea time with her family leisurely. My mother is not good at machines, so it shouldn't be complicated, but she just sets it up, presses the power button, and presses start, so my mother uses it very well. She said that this is the best gift she has ever received in her life. I am also proud to have given it to her and I am very happy. I used the 6-person one and it was good, but the 14-person one is really good. It can hold all the pots and large dishes. I am also planning to buy a built-in 14-person one when I move later. Since I am pregnant, my mother-in-law always cooks dinner and washes the dishes and doesn't let me into the kitchen, so I feel sorry and I also feel sorry for taking care of my firstborn, so I bought a built-in 14-person dishwasher this time. I thought I had to do it quickly without thinking, so I bought it right away, but thinking about it, I didn't think about the space when I bought it. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was so kind. First, he came to check and said it could be installed under the induction, but he said it couldn't be done right away. He said that the heat from the dishwasher rises and damages the induction. When we asked the company, they said we only needed to raise the height by 3 cm. After purchasing it and installing it, we made an appointment with the technician, but he was very busy. The installation was done late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening, fixed it, and barely managed to install the dishwasher. I was wondering what would happen if it didn't work out, but the technician was so kind. The installation was done late into the evening. My in-laws' apartment is over 20 years old, so they said that most of the sink was leaking, so they called a plumbing technician that evening, fixed it, and barely managed to install the dishwasher. Both are extremely quiet, clean very well, and allow energy consumption tracking in the app. Some have pointed out that dishes can come out a little wet, but I notice this mostly with plastics and if I'm low on rinse aid. Again, very happy with my choice and look forward to shopping other Bosch appliances in the future.

Sentence (English): Definitely the best dishwasher make in the industry.
Comments (English): [ Great Product but some issues with purchase and op ] || ---------------- || Definitely the best dishwasher make in the industry. This is my second one. The first lasted over 20 years and could've lasted another 5 with some disassembly and cleaning. First the installation. I installed it myself and glad I did. The earlier unit was hardwired and this one has a 3-prong plug so I installed an outlet. The folks who installed the last one did a sloppy job and left a gaping 4X4 hole in the bottom of the back wall which obviously was a route in and out of the kitchen for carpenter ants. If I paid for an installer, the cost would've been much higher because those types of repairs and additions are not covered in the cost. Also, the drain hose connection is not removeable so needed to bore out a bigger hole. These types of projects are not difficult but being 6'2" and working in a cramped area was not fun. Regarding the leveling, if you have a decent floor get the front AND back level before you push it into the space. Then once it's in it's just a minor adjustment. If you have a panel ready dishwasher, follow the template closely. For some reason I was 1/2" low and had to reinstall the clips. Next the operation. Extremely easy, extremely quiet. The old one and this one are so quiet you couldn't tell if it was on or not. This one has a floor facing red LED that tells you that it's running. The only major shortfall on the new one is that there is no indication whether the dishwashwer was run, so it's very easy for someone to add dirty dishes to the clean ones. This was enough of a problem that we put a sticky note on the door when clean. Another nuisance is the internet connection for HomeConnect. I wasted many hours trying to get the dishwasher to connect to my Netgear mesh router with no success. Who in the world needs an internet connection for a dishwasher? You may think I'm old school by this comment, but I am a certified LAN specialist and this should not happen. HomeConnect offers absolutely no valuable help. Total waste of my time. The only benefit that would have would be to tell you if the dishwasher was run and had clean dishes in it, something that the old unit did with a simple LED light. The new dish loading trays are good but takes some getting used to. I especially like the top tray for silverware because I don't have to bend down to load it. It takes more time to load than simply throwing a bunch of knives and forks into the bottom tray container, but it saves time when you unload it if you position like silverware next to each other and no need to sort it. The adjustable middle tray will come in handy but haven't needed to adjust it yet. Next and my main complaint, the purchase. I purchased it before Thanksgiving 2024. There was a $100 rebate available on units that were purchased before black Friday. The dishwasher arrived about a week and a half later, and then another few days before I had it installed and running. When I called the dealer to find out how to claim the rebate, the instructions had disappeared from the Bosch website. When the dealer contacted the Bosch rep, they said that the rebate ended on December 6th and there was no way to get it. I was prepared to address it directly with Bosch when the dealer decided to cover the $100 themselves. I think it came out of the dealer's pocket, which is not fair to the dealer. Because of this and despite the excellent quality of the unit, I will never buy another Bosch product again, and everyone I speak to about it will be aware of what happened. Shame on you Bosch, not only for removing the rebate but refusing to honor it. Overall, this is a great product that will probably outlive me, but beware of any rebate offerings and don't trust the manufacturer to live up to their offers.

Comments (English): [ Design flaw ] || ---------------- || Cleaned VERY well for first 2 months. Then the Control bar started flashing and failed, they came out and fixed it because it was under warranty and the repair man said it was a bad design because water gets under the control board since it's on top and not sealed well. I find it ridiculous, and since it had been too long by the time, it broke the second time it was out of warranty because Costco only has like three months For returns on appliances. Comments (English): [ Lowe' and Whirlpool have permanently lost a custom ] || ---------------- || By a wide margin the worst purchase of the past decade. This was meant to be a transitional dishwasher between one that gave out and a higher end one we intentend to purchase when we renovate our kitchen in 5 years, (due to some unique plumbing choices from prior home owners.) Once within the 12 month manufacture warranty, another 24 days after the warranty. They give you 1 year for a reason. This product will only last you 1 year. The cost to troubleshoot the issue and buy the parts will end up costing you about the same as the original purchase price. When I purchased this product I actually said "I am going to baby this because I don't want it giving out before we buy a nicer one". Lowe's will do nothing to help you but shrug their shoulders, while acknowledging that they sold you a lemon. Please, from the bottom of my heart, do not purchase this product and take your money elsewhere.

Sentence (English): My previous Bosch dishwasher lasted me 15 years, so I didn't hesitate to buy another one from the same brand.

In my previous dishwasher there were traces of dried drops and in this one, with the system of opening the door for better drying, there are no marks on the dishes and glasses.
